summary: Dream Finders Homes, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing the redemption of all 150,000 outstanding shares of its Series A Convertible Preferred Stock on September 14, 2026, at $1,028.50 per share, aggregating approximately $154.3 million. The redemption is pursuant to a separate notice to holders and constitutes a capital return event reducing preferred equity. No board recommendation or advisor is mentioned. The mechanics involve mandatory redemption of convertible preferred, potentially removing conversion overhang on common stock. What to watch: shareholder reaction, financing source, and any effect on common share dilution.
